generated_files.description: Core types (EffectCheckResult, EffectEntry, EffectContext), comparison helpers, built-in effect validation, alias expansion, built-in function effect mapping
Environment building from declarations, effect name validation against built-in/alias/user-defined effects

error_codes_used.E3001: MissingEffectCapability - function body uses effect not declared in signature
error_codes_used.E3002: EffectNotActive - required effect not subsumed by declared effects
error_codes_used.E3005: UndeclaredEffect - effect name not recognized as built-in, alias, or user-defined
error_codes_used.E3007: InvalidEffectParameter - invalid parameter on an effect alias
